scope: Retrospective, already consumed independent original CausalGym FKP26 public logs; no source first-use; scientifically honest robustness/falsification of CVH04 selective-coverage MSE signal and off-policy identification.
knowledge_about_scores: Prior CVH04 fixed split TRAIN 996100/996101 vs held 996102/996103 yielded support 55/62 and global prior MSE reduction 0.014917846867. 124 original rewards aggregate, 4 episodes summary, entire source now consumed. This 6-fold evaluation is deliberately retrospective and its scientific threshold is not a prospective discovery.

per_fold.labels: Four-step discounted future observed earned return r[t]+0.5r[t+1]+0.25r[t+2]+0.125r[t+3] until episode closes.
per_fold.prefix: prior public action,reward; current before and recorded action
per_fold.abstention: CVH01 support count less than 2 => abstain. Do not impute as native prediction.
per_fold.predictions: seal from train-only public consequences; evaluator computes historical held return targets afterward
per_fold.cold: checkpoint exact cold restore before predictions; train values and cold checksum preserved after isolated held-update replay

candidate.implementation: Reuse unchanged CVH01 EarnedReturnMemory from original CVH04 parent; no learned method edit
candidate.confident_wrong_definition: Not applicable to continuous earned return; report MSE; don't claim zero wrong binary effects

controls.information_equivalent_exact: Reuse independently implemented batch_public_returns on identical train tape; candidate must tie on every supported prediction, otherwise engineering FAIL
controls.global_train_prior: mean observed four-step train return, evaluated on candidate-supported rows and all held rows
controls.simple_fitted_4_cell: train-only mean four-step return grouped by public (before, action), two pseudocounts to train global prior; all held rows, no future labels
controls.bayesian36: fitted 2-pseudocount shrinkage to train global, all held rows; independently batch fitted
controls.immediate_only: reused original independent immediate-only estimator, candidate-supported rows
controls.no_train: global TRAIN mean. Distinguish fallback versus native-supported

predeclared_robustness.if_fail: RETROSPECTIVE_DEVELOPMENT_ROBUSTNESS_NO_GO, preserve CVH04 positive single-split as historical without retuning source, model, contexts or thresholds
predeclared_robustness.if_pass: RETROSPECTIVE_DEVELOPMENT_ROBUSTNESS_PASS_ONLY, still not scientific superiority or independent source learning

identifiability.behavior_policy: Original FKP24 fixed public action is (before_state+current_episode_row_index)%2, deterministic given public observation and local time index.
identifiability.witness: For each of 124 original public event histories, define two potential reward completion tables for the UNEXECUTED opposite action: 0 versus 1. Both completions reproduce all already witnessed source transitions and rewards, but disagree on 124 counterfactual rewards. This logical test proves logged fixed-policy data alone cannot identify unexecuted action reward (not an assertion about the upstream actual SCM).
identifiability.model_claim: Cannot claim improved online action selection or off-policy causal decision from these logs; require new owner-authorized prospective interaction with randomized/matched baseline actions.

reproducibility.seed: No new random source; deterministic enumeration 6 pairs and 4 original tapes
reproducibility.windows_linux: Same 12-decimal report normalization as CVH04, raw science comparisons unchanged, identical source and predictions/checkpoint SHA
negative_controls: mutate source fixture row => reject source SHA
assert 6 train pairs exactly unique and each held unused in training
strong exact symbolic tie every fold
single-split CVH04 frozen MSE/coverage reproduced exactly
counterfactual witness must not be used to train model or called genuine source action
reproducibility.qualification: Mandatory final exact SHA/tree regression root+CVH01..05+G29 Ubuntu/Windows; only generated G29 files and no main merge
